name: Baseball Scoreboard
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Live, recent, and upcoming baseball games across MLB, MiLB, and NCAA Baseball with real-time scores and schedules

versions.notes: Stop polling for live games on a live cadence when a league has nothing on. The interval was chosen by asking whether the last check happened within the last 300 seconds, and only then using no_data_interval -- but once 300s had elapsed the answer became no, the interval fell back to live_update_interval, and it fetched. no_data_interval could therefore never delay anything past 300s whatever it was set to. Measured on a live rig in mid-August: an out-of-season NHL fetched 0 games every ~5.5 minutes around the clock, roughly 264 wasted requests a day for one league. The interval now comes from a streak of empty looks, escalating 300s to 600s to 900s and capped, which any live game resets immediately -- about 96 checks a day out of season instead of 288, with the first game after a quiet spell still noticed within the cap. Both the idle interval and its ceiling are advanced settings.

Make the schedule fetch window configurable. How far back and forward games are fetched was hard-coded at 14 days back and 7 forward. Days is the wrong unit for a league that plays weekly -- a whole matchweek can fall just past a short horizon and never reach the board -- so both are now advanced settings, bounded 1-60 days, with a stray or non-numeric value falling back to the default rather than raising. Defaults keep today's behaviour.

Load the bundled fonts without depending on the process working directory. Every font this scoreboard draws with ships in the LEDMatrix core and was named relative to the cwd, which resolves only under the packaged systemd unit, whose WorkingDirectory is the install root. Anywhere else -- the plugin safety harness, a manual run from a home directory, a unit file written without WorkingDirectory -- the load raised, the caller's fallback caught it, and the scoreboard rendered in PIL's default face at the wrong metrics instead of the pixel font its layout was built around. Every direct load now goes through a resolver that tries the path as given, then the core install root, then returns the original so existing fallbacks are untouched; a configured absolute path still passes through unchanged.

Honour the configured live-game dwell instead of the data refresh rate. The rotation lived in update(), which runs on live_update_interval -- 30s by default -- so a game could only be advanced at that cadence and every configured duration was quantised to it. Measured on a live rig with four NFL games: live_game_duration=45 and non_favorite_live_game_duration=10 both produced a flat 30s rotation, and only changing live_update_interval changed anything. It is driven from display() now, so a dwell shorter than the refresh interval is reachable and a longer one is not cut short.

Match favorites against this plugin's real live-data shape. The first cut looked for an attribute holding live_games beside favorite_teams, which is true of five scoreboards and quietly false for four: cricket keeps live_matches, nrl and afl hold their managers in a dict rather than as attributes, and ufc has favorite_fighters and fighter names. Those four reported every live game as non-favorite. A celebrating game is searched too, since the live manager snapshots it out of live_games while the celebration is on screen.

Ask for more turns in the Vegas ticker while a game is live, and more again when a favorite team is playing. Only takes effect with the core's display.vegas_scroll.live_in_ticker set, which keeps the marquee running instead of handing the display to a full-screen scoreboard. The core grants a live plugin live_weight on its own; this reports the favorite case, which the core cannot see -- it knows a game is live but not whose.

Fix blurry score digits on the LED matrix: the outline-drawing helper used PIL's default anti-aliased text rendering, which blends pixel-font (PressStart2P) glyph edges into dim partial-lit pixels on a 1:1 matrix, muddying numbers (a "6" could read as a "G"). Text now draws in 1-bit font mode so every glyph -- scores, clocks, team names, status text -- renders crisp with no anti-aliasing.

Measure the top row by the span the card actually draws, not by a re-derived string. The check assumed one font and pure centring, but an upcoming card with swap_date_time draws the date in `detail` rather than `time` and shifts it by that element's x_offset, so the odds could be moved down when nothing was in the way or left overlapping when something was.

Measure the top-row text each card actually draws before deciding whether the odds must step down a row. The check always measured the live card's inning indicator, but a recent card centres "Final" there and an upcoming card a time or date, so on narrow panels it compared against a string that was not on the screen.

Draw betting odds at the top edge, matching every other scoreboard. They sat a whole text row lower (8px with the 4x6 font, 10px with PressStart2P), so the same element landed a third of a 32px card lower here than on football, basketball, soccer, afl, nrl and ufc. The lower row existed to clear the centred inning text, which baseball alone draws on that row, so the odds now step down only when they would genuinely collide -- measured from the actual strings rather than keyed to a panel size, because it is the text widths that decide: on a 64px panel "O/U: 8.5" clears the inning by 2px while "O/U: 12.5" overlaps it. Every panel 128px and wider uses the top edge unconditionally.

Scroll and Vegas cards: never show 0-0 before a game starts, add a centre gap so the score or VS is not drawn on top of the team logos, and write upcoming dates as "Sep 19". A new scroll_card config block sets what fills the middle of an upcoming card (VS, or the date and time stacked), the date format (abbrev/numeric) and the centre gap in pixels. gap_between_games is now honoured in Vegas mode, which stitches its own items and previously ignored it, and its code default moves from 24 to 48 to match the config schema. The date is positioned from its measured height rather than a fixed offset, which stops "Sep 19" running past the bottom of the card in the plugins whose detail font is 10px. These settings only affect the cards built for scroll and Vegas modes; the full-screen scoreboard is drawn by a separate code path and is unchanged. Adds a fuller set of scroll_card settings: vs_text (VS, @, at, ...), date_format now covering abbrev/numeric/day_first/numeric_day_first/weekday, time_format 12h or 24h, show_date, show_time, swap_date_time, upcoming_center gains a 'none' option, and center_gap_ratio/min/max for the automatic gap. Each customization text element gains text_color, and the customization.layout X/Y offsets are now honoured by the scroll/Vegas card -- the schema advertised them but only the full-screen scoreboard read them before. The away team is drawn on the left and the home team on the right, so "at" and "@" read correctly as "away at home".

Add customization.favorite_result_colors: an optional setting that colors a recent game's final score green when your favorite team won and red when it lost. Aimed at scroll and Vegas modes, where the same matchup can go past several times and the logos alone do not say who won. Off by default; games without exactly one favorite team keep the normal score color. Also changes the recent card's untinted score from gold to white, matching this plugin's own switch-mode scorebug and every other scoreboard; it was the only card drawing a final score gold.

Fix ESPN 403s. Around 2026-08-04 ESPN's site.api began rejecting both browser-style and bare custom User-Agent strings, which returned 403 Forbidden for every request this plugin made. Requests now send an identifying agent with the project URL, which ESPN accepts. No behaviour change beyond the header.

Test-only: the scroll display is now constructed on both the core and fallback paths, and its separator icons compared between them. The previous checks verified that methods existed and that their globals resolved, which could not see a constant read off self -- the miss that broke scroll mode in three sibling plugins.

Scroll display now uses the core's shared sports-scroll orchestration (LEDMatrix 3.2.0) when available, falling back to the bundled implementation on older cores. No behaviour change: all 24 harness renders are byte-for-byte identical.

Fix Vegas scroll mode showing only a single game: get_vegas_content() inherited whichever standalone display mode had rendered last, so one live game collapsed the whole ticker entry to one card. It now reads a dedicated combined live/recent/upcoming slate that the standalone modes cannot clobber, rebuilt only when the games actually change. Also stops the Vegas build doing network I/O on the render path (which froze the ticker) and stops it hijacking an in-progress standalone scroll.

Fix game start times rendering in UTC. The plugin looked for the LEDMatrix global timezone only on cache_manager.config_manager; on cores that expose config_manager via the plugin manager instead, that lookup found nothing and every start time was drawn in UTC (a 6:45pm Central first pitch showed as 11:45PM) even though the clock plugin was correct on the same device. Timezone resolution now checks the plugin override, then both config managers, then the host system zone, before falling back to UTC. Adds a documented timezone setting under Advanced Settings -- previously the key was rejected by the config schema, so hand-editing it had no effect -- and stops the plugin writing a resolved timezone back into the saved config.

Live games now honor the Home/Away logo x/y offset settings (customization.layout.home_logo / away_logo), matching how upcoming and recent games already behave. Previously the live scorebug hardcoded logo positions, so any configured offset was ignored and logos snapped back to the panel edges once a game went live.

Fix Live/Recent/Upcoming Display Mode set to Scroll being ignored outside Vegas mode -- granular per-league display (MLB, MiLB, NCAA Baseball rotation) always used switch/flip behavior and never consulted the display_mode setting or the scroll manager. Scroll now works for granular modes the same way it already did for Vegas mode. Config schema reorganized for a clearer setup experience: fine-tuning fields moved behind the web UI's collapsed Advanced Settings section (x-advanced). UX-only; no fields, defaults, or behavior changed.

Fix the Player Card's season-stat line ('AVG .312  HR 28  RBI 71') hard-truncating mid-pair on narrow panels (64x32 showed 'AVG .312  H', silently losing the HR/RBI values). Now drops whole trailing stat pairs -- 3 stats, then 2, then 1 -- until what's left fits, only truncating mid-string as a last resort if even a single stat overflows.

Traditional scoreboard: subtle team-color row tint + left-edge accent strip (toggle show_team_color_backgrounds). Pitcher/Batter screen: labels spelled out ('Pitcher:'/'Batter:') so 'B' is no longer ambiguous. New Player Card screen (show_player_card, MLB & NCAA): rotates in a full card for the current batter/pitcher with headshot, jersey number, position, bat/throw, and season stats (AVG/HR/RBI for hitters, ERA/W-L/K for pitchers); headshot hides on tiny panels, degrades to text-only when unavailable.

Add non_favorite_live_game_duration per league: give live games without a favorite team a shorter on-screen turn than your favorites. Applies only when favorite teams are set and non-favorite live games are shown (show_favorite_teams_only off, or show_all_live on); defaults to 0 (off) for unchanged behavior.
Log the BDF native-size retry's failure instead of silently swallowing it (was a bare except/pass, flagged by static analysis) -- font-loading fallback failures are now traceable.

Redesign the Pitcher/Batter/Last Play screen for visual parity with the Traditional Scoreboard: text is now centered both horizontally and vertically (was flush top-left), auto-fits the largest font that still fits every line's actual text -- falling back to a smaller same-family font, and truncating as a last resort, rather than overflowing -- instead of a small fixed size. Adds use_team_colors (default on): colors the pitcher's name with the fielding team's real ESPN color and the batter's name with the batting team's color.

Fix the Pitcher/Batter/Last Play screen's default font ('four_by_six') rendering 'B' and '8' almost identically, making last-play codes like 'BB' (walk) misreadable as '88'. Switched the default to '5x7.bdf', a small bitmap font with clearly distinct glyphs.

Fix a real KeyError('status') crash on live MiLB games (its converted-from-Stats-API events never carried a duplicate top-level status key the way real ESPN events do; _extract_game_details now correctly reuses the already-validated competition-level status instead of a separate, unreliable top-level lookup). Add favorites_only to the Pitcher/Batter/Last Play screen, matching the Traditional Scoreboard's option. Add highlight_winner (default on) to the Traditional Scoreboard: colors the winning team's run total on a final game so the winner is obvious at a glance, pairing naturally with game_scope: recent.

Add game_scope (live / recent / both) and favorites_only options for the Traditional Scoreboard screen, so it can be restricted to only live games, only final/recent games (handy for glancing at the winner via the final line score), and/or only your favorite teams -- independent of the league's normal show_all_live rotation. Also extends the screen to the recent-games manager (it previously only ever rotated in from the live manager), and documents the screen and all its toggles in the README.

Shrink the Traditional Scoreboard's ball/strike/out circle indicators further (they were still a bit overpowering) and move the batting-team ▲/▼ indicator out of the At Bat column into the header row's empty team-column cell, right next to the inning numbers.

Move the Traditional Scoreboard's At Bat ball/strike/out column back to the right of the grid (past R/H/E), still vertically aligned with the header/away/home rows and still always-on (3-row budget, factored into the inning-column count). Also shrink the ball/strike/out circle indicators slightly for a cleaner look.

Move the Traditional Scoreboard's At Bat ball/strike/out column permanently to the left of the grid (vertically aligned with the header/away/home rows) instead of only sometimes to the right or stacked below -- it now always budgets 3 rows of vertical space, so the grid font is consistently bigger, and its width is factored into how many innings fit so narrow displays show fewer innings rather than losing the column (it's dropped entirely only if even a single inning column wouldn't otherwise fit). Centers the whole combined block (At Bat column + team + grid + RHE) to minimize dead space on both sides. Also adds small team logos beside each abbreviation when there's leftover width to spare, toggle via the new show_logos option.

Fix the Traditional Scoreboard's At Bat side panel (added in 1.13.0) clipping its ball/strike/out dots off the right edge of the display -- the fit check compared leftover space against a flush-left grid, but the grid is actually centered, so it was eating into the panel's reserved space from the left too. Also account for the Outs row's extra batting-team ▲/▼ arrow, which wasn't factored into the width check at all.

On wide-enough displays, move the Traditional Scoreboard screen's At Bat ball/strike/out indicators into a compact side column (vertically aligned with the header/away/home rows) instead of stacking them below the grid -- that only needs 3 rows of vertical space instead of 6, so the whole grid renders noticeably bigger. Falls back to the below-grid layout automatically when there isn't enough leftover width beside the grid. Also fixes BDF font-size detection to read the file's real PIXEL_SIZE property instead of assuming point-size always equals pixel height, which was silently substituting the wrong font for a couple of sizes in the fallback ladder (6x13, 5x8) on 75dpi-defined fonts.

Switch the Traditional Scoreboard screen's default font from PressStart2P to 9x15 -- a cleaner, less blocky bitmap font -- with an automatic fallback ladder (9x15 -> 8x13 -> 7x13 -> 6x13 -> 6x12 -> 6x10 -> 6x9 -> 5x8 -> 5x7) that steps down to a smaller same-family font on displays too small to fit the default at full size, so no row gets clipped off. Also fixes font loading to resolve a .bdf file's real native pixel size instead of failing when a mismatched size is requested.

Redesign the Traditional Scoreboard screen for readability: switch to a retro pixel font at an auto-fit size that fills the display (configurable max via font_size), color each team's abbreviation with their real ESPN team colors (brightness-clamped for legibility, toggle via use_team_colors), add 1px grid divider lines between innings/rows/R-H-E columns, and cap the test-mode fixture's simulated game at 10 innings instead of climbing indefinitely.

Add an optional Traditional Scoreboard screen (MLB and NCAA Baseball only) -- a full-screen outfield-style scoreboard that periodically rotates into the live view: an inning-by-inning line score with R/H/E, the current inning highlighted, and (for leagues with count data) an At Bat panel with lit ball/strike/out indicators. Automatically fits as many innings as the display width allows, scrolling to a trailing window once the game progresses further than that. Toggle per league under Display Options > Show Traditional Scoreboard; customize font/colors/timing under Customization > Traditional Scoreboard Screen.

Add optional Pitcher/Batter and Last Play info (MLB and NCAA Baseball only) -- a dedicated screen that periodically rotates into the live view showing the current at-bat's pitcher, batter, and a short code for the most recently completed play (1B, HR, K, BB, etc.). Toggle per league under Display Options; customize font/colors/timing under Customization > Pitcher / Batter / Last Play Screen. Fetches the extra per-game data on a background thread with a bounded timeout so a slow response can't block the render loop.

Apply config changes live via on_config_change (favorite teams, league enable/disable, durations, live priority, display modes); rebuilds the league managers, registry, scroll manager and rotation so edits take effect without a display restart.

Add exclude_teams (hide specific teams from live rotation and recent/final scores — spoiler protection) and filtering.favorite_live_boost (tune how much more often your favorite's live game appears in rotation vs other live games) per league.

Resolve font family aliases (press_start, four_by_six, five_by_seven) to their real font files when loading fonts. These are the default values shipped in the config schema, but the loaders treated them as literal filenames and logged 'Font file not found ... using default' on every load before silently falling back. Aliases now map to the correct files; literal filenames still pass through unchanged.

Disable anti-aliasing when drawing the outlined text (scores, status, date). The pixel/bitmap fonts (e.g. PressStart2P) were being anti-aliased into dim partial-lit pixels on a 1:1 LED matrix, muddying glyphs so a '6' could read as a 'G'. Drawing in 1-bit mode keeps digits crisp.

Fix MiLB/NCAA logo layout: crop transparent padding before scaling, cap logo height at 75% of display height, default game card width to full display width so logos anchor at display edges instead of center
Fix test_mode: pass the flag through to the live manager and short-circuit update() so the simulated live game is not overwritten by an empty live fetch
